candidate.failure_pattern: All 29 Configio words reject with no_eipmodules_bank_match although their even Low banks are represented in the EIP bank map.
candidate.candidate_rule_description: Normalize the catalog prefix from Desc; use In_Out to constrain direction; for a Low/High 16-bit pair normalize High Bank to Low Bank (High - 1); match the normalized bank against input_bank or output_bank.
